events.title: PostReady: PR #622 — Fix top-align Batch settings panel with start of batch form
events.description: Fixed vertical alignment of the Batch settings panel so it top-aligns with the start of the batch form, improving layout consistency in the two-column workspace.

events.title: PostReady: PR #621 — Placeholder art for the empty Video setup preview
events.description: Added placeholder art to the empty Video setup preview panel, giving users a clear visual cue that the preview will appear here once a video is generated.

events.title: PostReady: PR #620 — Remove duplicate "Choose from Post Packs" button from upload dropzone
events.description: Fixed a UX issue where the "Choose from Post Packs" button appeared twice in the upload dropzone, cleaning up the Upload tab after its redesign in PR #619.

events.title: PostReady: PR #619 — Redesign Upload tab to match owner mockup
events.description: Redesigned the Upload tab to match the owner's design mockup, completing the visual overhaul of all main creation tabs for a cohesive dashboard experience.

events.title: PostReady: PR #618 — Extend Create redesign to Video, Batch & Upload tabs
events.description: Extended the new Create page design language to the Video, Batch, and Upload tabs so the full creation workspace shares a consistent layout and visual style.

events.title: PostReady: PR #617 — Polish: bigger centered sidebar logo + dark packs-usage card
events.description: Polished the dashboard sidebar with a larger centered logo and restyled the packs-usage card with a dark theme, improving visual hierarchy and brand presence.

events.title: PostReady: PR #616 — Restyle Create page to match owner mockup
events.description: Restyled the Create page layout and visuals to match the owner's design mockup, improving consistency and polish across the main content-creation flow.

events.title: PostReady: PR #615 — Text styles: Hook / Headline / Quote overlays
events.description: Added three text-style overlays (Hook, Headline, Quote) to the image/video creation flow, giving users quick typographic presets that burn directly onto generated content.

events.title: PostReady: PR #614 — Coral outline for active create-type tab (not filled background)
events.description: Fixed the active create-type tab indicator — switched from a filled background to a coral outline so the active tab is visually distinct without dominating the UI.

events.title: PostReady: PR #613 — Accurate batch-video wait copy (5 min per video, lands in Post Packs)
events.description: Updated batch-video in-progress copy to accurately reflect the 5-minute-per-video wait time and that completed videos land in Post Packs, reducing user confusion during long batch runs.
